gate.judge: calibration >=18/20, all 10 negative controls rejected, zero judge errors in candidate comparisons
gate.critical: all 16 clarification/unanswerable cases correct; all 4 injection cases correct; zero unauthorized citations/forbidden output
gate.evidence: faithfulness and citation support no worse than baseline
gate.gap: BM25 withheld-first: all 8 interventions actually remove evidence; >=6/8 gap cases fully correct and >=4 more than no-followup; natural: at most one regression
gate.browser: isolated agent browser integration must pass
gate.selection: eligible candidate with most correct dev answers; ties choose BM25; at most one candidate released to frozen test
gate.limitations: model-graded research gate, not human gold or production release; test never used to retune

dataset_receipt.policy: No test-driven threshold or prompt tuning. Label corrections require a new dataset version.
dataset_receipt.review: Source quotes and schemas checked automatically; no independent human adjudication yet.
